name: Tides of Madness
summary: Two-player Lovecraftian card-drafting game where collecting sets scores points while flirting with madness.
rules_text: Two players play over three rounds. Each round a hand of cards is dealt; players simultaneously choose one card to keep in front of them and pass the rest to the opponent, repeating until hands are empty. Between rounds one kept card is retained permanently, the rest form your final tableau, and a new hand is dealt. Many cards score for having sets of suits, like red towers or ancient races symbols. Some cards have madness icons. At end of each round, the player with more madness icons this round gains 4 points or heals 1 accumulated madness. Track total madness across rounds; if any player reaches 9 or more total madness they lose instantly. Otherwise after three rounds the player with most points from set scoring plus madness bonuses wins.
rating_reason: Specific 2p drafting card game, hidden hands, strategic
